mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.meal_type, f.name as food_name, mr.amount, ROUND(f.calories * mr.amount / f.unit_gram) as calories, ROUND(f.protein * mr.amount / f.unit_gram) as protein, ROUND(f.fat * mr.amount / f.unit_gram) as fat, ROUND(f.carbs * mr.amount / f.unit_gram) as carbs FROM meal_record mr LEFT JOIN food f ON mr.food_id = f.id WHERE mr.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY mr.meal_date, mr.meal_type, mr.id

SELECT mr.meal_date, SUM(ROUND(f.calories * mr.amount / f.unit_gram)) as total_calories, SUM(ROUND(f.protein * mr.amount / f.unit_gram)) as total_protein, SUM(ROUND(f.fat * mr.amount / f.unit_gram)) as total_fat, SUM(ROUND(f.carbs * mr.amount / f.unit_gram)) as total_carbs FROM meal_record mr LEFT JOIN food f ON mr.food_id = f.id WHERE mr.meal_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY mr.meal_date ORDER BY mr.meal_date
